title: driver-sql / driver-turso: pin the atomicity of the NOW() ADD COLUMN + backfill (a failing fill rolls the ADD COLUMN back) on each door
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYtTDvfPQDzMbZnN5X

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (L2 S5 of seat repo:objectstack#5 on PR #37469, delta contract record on head `835c89df`). Follow-up of #37413. Per the maintainer's rule, a simple issue becomes a follow-up card: the behaviour is implemented, and only its pin is missing.

reach: read at PR #37469 head `835c89df` · evidence: read. Dropping the local `knex.transaction` or splitting the remote `write` batch leaves every test green.

## What

PR #37469 makes `ADD COLUMN` plus the `NOW()` backfill atomic in three places:
- one `knex.transaction` on the local managed door;
- one `knex.transaction` on the local shard door;
- one `write` batch on remote `syncSchema`.

No test fails if any of those is removed. A fill that fails after the column exists would then leave NULL rows that no re-sync refills, and a nullable field reports nothing.

## Expected

For each door, a test makes the fill fail (an injected UPDATE error) and asserts that the column is absent afterwards, and that a re-sync adds and fills it. The test must turn red when the transaction or batch is removed.
